propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state the close precheck requires a MERGED rebar-ticket commit, when it actually accepts ANY commit reachable from HEAD with the correct trailer or subject, regardless of merge status.
The precheck is conditional on recorded file_impact and require_completion_verification_for_close gate being enabled, but documentation presents it as unconditional.

The rebar transition --ref flag, which allows closing stacked stories against their own commit without moving the worktree, is completely undocumented in AGENTS.md despite being documented in transition.txt and plan-review-gate.md.
The land-before-close ordering is enforced by the Verified +1 policy rule, not by the precheck mechanism, but documentation implies the precheck enforces it.
The precheck scans the entire history reachable from current HEAD with git log and no ref argument, accepting referencing commits for the ticket or any transitive descendant from list_descendants.
